product_brief: Java security provider (OpenSSLProvider) using BoringSSL to perform the actual cryptographic operations, including TLS contexts, signatures, ciphers, and key generation.
pqc_support: Yes — ML-DSA (44/65/87), composite ML-DSA, ML-KEM (768/1024), X-Wing and SLH-DSA key generators/factories/signatures registered in the provider

product_brief: Go package implementing Hybrid Public Key Encryption (HPKE) as defined in RFC 9180, with classical and ML-KEM-based KEMs.
pqc_support: Yes — ML-KEM-768, ML-KEM-1024 and hybrid MLKEM768-X25519 (X-Wing), MLKEM768-P256, MLKEM1024-P384 KEMs per draft-ietf-hpke-pq
pqc_capability_description: Provides HPKE KEMs MLKEM768, MLKEM1024, and hybrids MLKEM768X25519 (X-Wing), MLKEM768P256, MLKEM1024P384 from draft-ietf-hpke-pq. Includes constructors wrapping crypto/mlkem keys. Maturity as a draft-based implementation; the document does not give a production status.
crypto_primitives: DHKEM (P-256, P-384, P-521, X25519), ML-KEM-768, ML-KEM-1024, hybrid ML-KEM+X25519/P-256/P-384, HKDF-SHA256/384/512, SHAKE128, SHAKE256, AES-128-GCM, AES-256-GCM, ChaCha20Poly1305

evidence.PQC Capability Description: MLKEM1024P384 returns a KEM implementing MLKEM1024-P384 from draft-ietf-hpke-pq.
evidence.Crypto Primitives: HKDFSHA256 returns an HKDF-SHA256 KDF implementation.
evidence.Hybrid KEM Support: MLKEM768X25519 returns a KEM implementing MLKEM768-X25519 (a.k.a. X-Wing) from draft-ietf-hpke-pq.

product_brief: JavaScript module for Hybrid Public Key Encryption (HPKE) that works across Node.js, browsers, Cloudflare Workers, Deno, and Bun, with zero dependencies.
pqc_support: Yes — ML-KEM-512/768/1024 and hybrid MLKEM768-P256, MLKEM768-X25519, MLKEM1024-P384 KEMs
pqc_capability_description: Built-in KEMs include ML-KEM-512, ML-KEM-768, ML-KEM-1024 and PQ/T hybrids MLKEM768-P256, MLKEM768-X25519, MLKEM1024-P384, built on Web Cryptography Modern Algorithms. Availability varies by runtime (some need the webcrypto_modern_algorithms flag). Tested with spec test vectors.
crypto_primitives: DHKEM(P-256/P-384/P-521, HKDF), DHKEM(X25519/X448), ML-KEM-512/768/1024, MLKEM768-P256, MLKEM768-X25519, MLKEM1024-P384, HKDF-SHA256/384/512, SHAKE128/256, TurboSHAKE128/256, AES-128-GCM, AES-256-GCM, ChaCha20Poly1305
architecture_type: Library (HPKE implementation built on Web Cryptography, extensible via KEM/KDF/AEAD interfaces)
primary_platforms: Node.js, Deno, Bun, Cloudflare Workers, browsers, Electron
testing_&_validation_methods: Algorithm implementations are tested using test vectors from their respective specifications.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Zero dependencies; exports tree-shakeable ESM; distributed via npmjs.com, jsdelivr.com, and github.com.
